tei:div.tei:p: mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros kyi lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /'dir gleng par bya ba ni/ lho brag mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros te/ de yang lho brag chu khyer du gdung rus mar pa/ yab dbang phyug 'od zer dang*/ yum skal ldan skyid gnyis la lcam dral lnga yod pa'i lnga tshigs 'khrul bral kaḥthog pa chen pos lcags byir 'khrungs par bzhed/ gzhon nu nas yi ge bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ shin tu thu bas yab yum gyis dul du re nas dgung lo bcu gnyis lon par chos la brdzangs pas mang mkhar myu gu lung du 'brog mi lo tsā las lo tsā byang bar bslab/ der gsang sngags kyi chos 'dod kyang yon che la bka' dogs pas/ rgya gar 'gro ba'i spob pa skyes te ka ca rnams gser du bsgyur nas klog skya chen po de stag sder pheb pa dang 'grul nas sgyer phur phebs/ gzhi len dang rdzong ba mdzad/ slad nas khong gi bu kun gyis shangs len byas pa'i chad tho byas nas mang yul du phebs te gnyos 'byung po dang stabs gcig bal yul phebs nas lo gsum du bzhugs/ bal po pham thing pa rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde la gdan bzhi'i bdag gdan gyi bshad bka' zhus/ sgra tshad dang sman dpyad sogs zhar chos mdzad/ de nas rje nā ro pa'i snyan pa gsan te/ bal po ban+de pa dang 'grul nas rgya gar du byon/ bi kra ma la shī lar phyags 'byor dge tshul shes rab seṅge dang mjal/ de skabs jo bo rje dbus kyi ka chen dzñān shrī mi tra'i nye gnas yin 'dug nā ro pa rgya gar shar phyogs su byon pa ljongs me tog rgyas par dpal nā ro pa dang mjal/ tshogs 'khor dang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhu ba phul/ thog mar dpal dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur skabs dkyil 'khor mngon sum du sprul nas dbang lha dang bla ma gang la zhu 'dom gsungs pas/ da res lha mngon sum la zhu zhus pas/ dkyil 'khor thugs kar bsdus te/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin pas/ khyod kyis bla ma las yi dam 'dam pas/

mi brgyud kyis phan mi thog chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung lta bu 'byung bar lung bstan/ dbang don gyi ye shes ngo 'phrod/ de nas puṣ+pa ha rir phebs nas gur brtag saṃ gsum gyi bshad bka' dang dbang lung man ngag bsre 'pho gnad kyi gdams pa dang*/ gdan bzhi ma hā mā yā sogs dang gur gyi mgon po dud sol ma bcas gnang*/ de nas tshong 'dus su gnyos lo dang 'phrad pas dgyes rdor la chos skad byas pas mar pa rang rgyal/ pha rgyud 'dus pa zhes rlung spar 'dzin du bya ba de shes dgos zer nas de la lan ma theng nas/ bla ma la zhus pas nub du lak+ṣe tra'i dgon par gtsug lag khang zla ba rgyas pa na paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes snying po bya ba pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i mnga' bdag cig bzhugs pa der song gsungs pa bzhin du byon te/ ye shes snying po dang mjal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor dbang rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa zhus te bla ma'i drung du tshur 'khor nas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dzñā na ā kar sid+dhi zhes bya ba de gsang 'dus zhu bar byon pa dang 'grigs nas gsol ba btab pas da lam 'chad pa'i dus dang rten 'byung 'grigs gsungs nas de dang lhan cig dbang rgyud bshad bcas tshang bar gnang bas khyad par med pa las man ngag dngos zab par byung*/ paṇ+ḍi ta de ni nā ro pas kyang zhes 'bul dgos pa zhig 'dug cing*/ jo bo chen pos kyang de la 'dus pa 'phags skor zhu dgos pa la ma byung gsungs pa thos te/ paṇ+ḍi ta de bod du byon dus nag tsho lo tsā la 'dus pa 'phags skor rnams gnang nas bod 'di dag nā ro ta pa'i thugs sras bdag gi grogs po mar pa lo tsā'i gdul byar 'dug go zhes de nyid nas log ste o rgyan du bzhud par grags so/ / 'gos lo chen po'i 'phags skor gyi bla ma yang paṇ+ḍi ta 'di nyid de mnga' bdag mar pa'i chos grogs so// mar pa rgya gar du lan phyi mar byon skabs kyang du lak+ṣe trar byon pas dpal ye shes snying po nyid rigs ngan gyi bu mo zhig phyag rgya ma mdzad de bzhugs par/

phyag rgya ma de chu len par byung ba dang 'phrad pas bla ma la zhu phrin phul ba dang re zhig nas bum pa chus bkang ba zhig khyer byung nas chu 'di'i phyed kyis khrus gyis/ phyed ka 'thungs shig zer nas bum pa'i nang gi chu byang sems dkar por 'dug pa'i bum pa'i steng du mo rang bsdad nas mkha' gsang nas rak+ta'i rgyun phab pa'i phyed kyis khrus byas phyed btung nas da rung lhag ma yod dam bsam ste bltas pas bum nang du 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal zhing bla ma yang der pheb par phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul bas byin gyis brlab te sa brgyad pa mngon du gyur to// yang gnyos lo dang 'phrad de 'dus pa'i chos skad la khong rgyal yang*/ ma rgyud ma hā mā yā dgos zer/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lho dug mtsho'i gling na nag po shān+ti bha dra ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po bya ba ma rgyud kyi bdag po zhig yod pas der song zhig gsungs nas byon/ ha la pa ṭa'i mtsho'i do la bzhugs pa btsal bas nyi ma'i gung la smag rum mun pa 'thibs/ gsol ba btab pas mun pa sangs/ rje btsun dang mjal/ der pho nya dang 'phrad dam gsungs/ stag gzig dang 'phrad zhus pas/ de ka yin mod gsungs der tshogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ sgyu ma chen po'i dbang rgyud bshad sgrub thabs rnal 'byor gsum la sogs pa'i man ngag kun gnang ste tshur phyags 'khor bas/ bla ma nā ro pa nyid kyis de las bshad pa zab rgyas che tsam zhig gnang*/ de nas gnyos dang 'phrad de 'bel gtam mdzad pas kho rang mi smra bar gyur/ khyod kyis bla ma gang las sgyu ma chen po thob pa yin zer bas/ bla ma gsang ste thar pa'i lam ston yin byas so/ /rnam thar rnams su 'di dang ku ku ri pa gnyis gcig tu byas pa sogs mi legs pa 'ga' re snang ngo*// de nas rgya gar shar phyogs su ri bo me ltar 'bar ba'i dur khrod du mnga' bdag mai tri pa mjal/ thugs rjes lhag par gzung*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa rnams zhus/

dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa zhus shing ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul du ma yang mjal te/ ji skad du/ shing n+ya gro dha'i bsil grib la// rje mnga' bdag mai tri bzhugs pa mjal// rgyud zab mo bstod pa glur blang dang*// yi dam dgyes pa rdo rje zhus// mkha' nas me tog char du babs// sgron shing mar me mdzub gang la// zhag bdun bar du snang ba byung*// bem por gyur pa'i ljon shing des// rab tu ma bzod g.yo 'gul byas// sprul pa'i ce spyang dmar po bdun// dngos su gtor ma len pa mthong*// sa gsum gnas pa'i ḍā ki yis// gzugs med sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs// bar snang gang ba'i zhing skyong rnams// sna tshogs rol mo sgrogs pa thos// zhes pa ltar ro// mnga' bdag mai tri gup+ta 'di nyid dpal sha bā ri pa dang dngos su mjal zhing phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes brnyes pa dang*/ rgyal bas lung bstan shān+ti pa chen po'i slob ma'i mchog yin cing slob dpon 'di ni 'phags yul gyi thal rang rnams kyi sems tsam rnam rdzun du sgrogs pa'i nges don zab mo gzhan stong gi lta ba 'dzin pa yin cing*/ 'di dang shān+ti pa gnyis lta ba'i skor la rtsod pa thug zer ba ni shin tu mi bden te bud+dha gup+ta nā tha'i bka' stsal pa de ltar ro/ /der char zim zhig byung bar gyang skyibs zhig tu char yibs byed cing bzhuḍa pas/ lha khang zhig gi bya 'dabs kyi kha nas bud med zhig gis bya thal 'phyags kyin 'dug pa'i phyag ma lhung shor bar lag pa nar gyis brkyang nas blangs song ba gang yin dpyad pas mai tri pa'i gzungs ma chu shing gi snye ma can bya ba der 'dug pas/ de rang du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas gsang gdan le'u dang po'i rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dbang bskur dang*/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang dang gsang gdan gyi skor gnang*/ de nas nā ro'i zhabs pad du 'khor skabs rgya tshad 'dar bus grongs pa la thug pa bsnyun/

bla mas lung bstan te dur khrod so sa gling du byon nas rnal 'byor ma mi rus kyi rgyan can ma la gdan bzhi rdzogs par zhus/ bla ma nā ro pa las kyang gdan bzhi'i dbang rgyud zab khrid mtha' rgyas su zhus shing*/ dgyes rdor gyi dbang rgyud bshad lan bdun gsan pa dang*/ gzhan yang gshed skor rnams dang sgrol ma 'byung ba/ mi g.yo bla med/ sems 'grel skor gsum sogs rgyud sde'i dbang rgyud man ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan par mdzad na'ang*/ skabs der gdul bya dus la ma babs pa'am/ dus der bod rnams bde dgyes gsang gsum kho na zer ba'i skabs yin 'dug pas/ don gnyer med pa'am ci ltar na'ang sgrol ma 'byung ba dang sems 'grel gyi skor sogs bod yul 'dir su la'ang gnang skad mi 'dug cing*/ de la rje pad+ma dkar pos lo tsā chen pos rgyud sde rgya mtsho tsam mkhyen pa las phyogs 'dir bum pa gang tsam gnang ba zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de nas dur khrod so sa gling du tshogs 'khor la song dang ḍā' ki mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur gsungs pa ltar byon pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mi mo'i rnam pa dang mjal/ shel gyi gri gug gis thugs ka phyes te aṣ+ta sngags kyi 'khor lo bstan nas brda bzhi'i dbang bskur rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba mjal bar song zhig dang don chen po yod gsungs pa ltar byon pas/ tshems mche ba'i sgrom gyi nang du sngar med pa'i tā la'i lo ma la li khris siṅga la'i ye ger bris pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs 'dug pa mkha' 'gros gnang bar go nas/ dkor gnyer las slong ste bod du spyan drangs nas phyis bod skad du bsgyur ba ni da lta'i sgrub thabs 'di ka'o/ /dpal sa ra ha pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang mjal te ma hā mā yā'i dbang rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa gnang*/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ rje nā ro ta pas gtsor mdzad pa'i//

grub thob kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal// spyir rgyud sde bzhi yi man ngag/ zhes sogs dang*/ lar dur khrod nyul ba'i rnal 'byor pa// shing drung na gnas pa'i ku sa li// yongs su ma grags 'ga' yod de// rdzogs rim kha 'thor mang du zhus// ngo mtshar can gyi sgrub thabs dang*// phran tshegs gdams ngag rtsis las 'das// chos 'brel tsam gyi bla ma mang*// dpal siṅga la'i sna drangs pa'i// mngon shes grub rtags mnga' brnyes pa'i// snang ba 'gyur nges bcu gsum bzhugs// chos smon lam gyi 'brel thogs bcu gsum dang*// khyad par grub thob zhal lnga bzhugs// rje 'gran gyi do med rnam gnyis te// gtso bo paṇa chen nā ro pa// de 'og rgyal sras mai tri pa// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de nas bod du gser tshol la phebs nas bal yul du phyags 'byor skabs chu rgyas pas phyag dpe 'ga' zhig chu la shor bas grogs zhig las gser zho bzhi tsam skyis te rgya gar du ldog pas/ nā ro pas khyod kyis bod nas gser lon pa las chos kyi sgro 'dogs gcod du 'ong pa dga' gsungs/ sngar ma thos pa'i gdams ngag mang po zhus te lo gcig bzhugs/ de ltar rgya gar du lo bdun/ phar tshur du lo lnga ste khyon lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ de nas rgya dpe rnams la dogs gcod dang gzhi 'gyur mdzad/ de nas bla ma gnyos lo tsā ba bod yul du chas/ de yang sngon lo tsā ba rnams kyi spyi lugs la/ rgya dpe khur pa'i a tsa ra dang*/ rma bya khur gdugs bskor nas pheb pa yin pas/ rje 'di pas rgya dpe rgyab tu bsnam nas phebs pas/ gnyos los/ khyed ni paṇa chen nā ro pa'i thugs sras rgya gar na'ang mthong chen po byed/ slob gnyer dang spang rtogs nga las khyad par gyi che ba yin tsa na 'di ltar mu to ba'i chas mi dgos gsungs nas/ khong gi zhabs phyi a tsa ra zhig la rgya dpe sogs khur bcug gser phran tshegs kyang skyi 'grul gnang nas sdeb ste byon pa yin no//

lo rgyus dang mgur 'bum rnams su gnyos los mar pa'i rgya dpe rnams la chu la 'phangs zer ba kho na bris pa snang ba ni phyis kyi blun po 'gas bslad pa mngon te/ lo tsā ba'i rnam thar sngar gyi dpe rnying gnyis tsam mthong bar bshad ma thag pa de ltar snang zhing*/ rgya dpe chu la skur ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ 'bel gtam mdzad tshul rnams mi 'dug kyang*/ gzhan grags tsam bkod pa yin cing*/ de rnams ni nā ro pas lung bstan par gsungs 'dug cing rje dpa' bo'i chos 'byung du'ang de rig gi sgros tsam yang mi snang la/ sngon gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod pas skabs gsang nas spyod pa kho na yin pa la/ tshong 'dus su gsang sngags 'bel gtam byed pa'i lugs med cing*/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus gzigs pa'i mar pa'i rnam thar rnams su'ang gnyos los rgya dpe chu la 'phangs pa'i gtam de mi bden tshul dang*/ gnyos los rje mar par rgya gar du phan gdags mang po mdzad pa'i drin len du rje nā ro pa'i thugs dam rten bde mchog gi rdo sku dang rgya dpe sogs 'phags yul gyi yo byad kha shas gnang ba las rdo sku ni da lta yang gye re lha pa'i nang rten du bzhugs pa khong pas mjal gsungs 'dug pa bzhin dang*/ lar yang bla ma de thugs rgyud ches bzang bas dpa' rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po grub cing nus mthu chen po mnga' ba rwa lo las nus mthu ches che ba yin kyang srog chags grog sbur zhig la'ang gnod pa mi mdzad pa zhig yin pas 'bri gung skyobs pas mgar dam pa chos lding pa la 'jigs mdzad gnyos lugs zhus shig /gsungs pa ltar skyes bu dam pa des rgyud kyi glegs bam chur bskyur ba'i sdig spyod de 'dra mi gnang bas kyang mtshon no// de nas sgyer phur klog skya chen po 'das pa'i jo sras shes rab brtsegs kyis zhabs nas btegs/ der sgyu ma chen mo'i chos btsugs/ de nas yul du phyags phebs/

lho la yag gi ba rang lba ba can sogs 'dus par 'dus pa sogs kyi chos 'khor bskor/ jo bo mar pa dkon cog gis sa yul der phu+u na 'brog sa/ bar du dgon mal/ mda' ru zhing 'debs chog pa'i mna' gan phul/ de nas byang nam ra'i gser kha rdol ba dang thug der lha g.yag dkar po zhig shi ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar nas dad pa byas te/ gser mang du rnyed nas slar rgya gar du byon/ bla ma rnams la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal tshogs 'khor rgyas pa dang mchod pas mnyes par byas te/ de skabs nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs skabs yin kyang mjal te/ nā ro pa'i drung nas bde mchog lū dril nag gsum laṅka rgyal bzang gi lugs sogs rtsa rgyud kyi lugs srol mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ gzhan yang kun spyod dang a bhi dha na'i skor sogs dang*/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs dang*/ gshed skor sogs chos 'phros rnams zhus nas bod du 'gro ba'i gnang ba zhus pas/ lo tsā ba khyod rje tai lo pa chen pos lung gis bstan pa yin/ byang phyogs su 'gro ba'i don rgya chen 'byung gsungs/ mai tri pa las/ dgyes rdor dang bde mchog phag mo sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga pa dang dgu pa sogs zhus/ gzhan yang sngar ma gsan pa rnams gsan/ gsan pa rnams la dogs gcod dang 'gyur bcos mdzad de/ lo drug zla ba bdun tsam du 'phags yul du bzhugs nas bla ma rnams la phyi phyag 'tshal nas bod du chas bal por phebs/ der mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug rgya gar du byon pa dang mjal nas phyag rten phul bas/ nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs zin pas/ nā ro'i slob ma bzhi la chos nyon zhes gsungs nas bod du phebs song zer ba mar do'i rnam thar du yod/

gzhan yang blun po phyogs zhen yin du re ba 'gas mar pas nā ro ta pa ma mjal zhes sa skya rje btsun gyi gsung du brdzus te byas pa la/ blun po phyi ma rnams kyis rjes zlos byed mod/ 'jam dbyangs sa pan gyis/ nā ro'i chos drug lugs gnyis dang zhes gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal zhing*/ de bzhin du lho brag mgon po zangs gri can gyi brgyud pa'ang gang la 'ded bsam dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang jo bo chen pos khyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa ni mkha' spyod du gshegs zin gsungs pa de'i snyegs mtshams gang la byed shes ldan rnams kyis sems par byas na log rtog de rnams sel bar 'gyur ro// mes rngog mtshur dbang nge sogs rjes su bzung*/ de nas 'phan yul nas byang 'dam gyi bar phebs/ snying drung du mar pa mgo yag gis gdan drangs gser gsang bzhi bcu sogs phul/ der tho rangs zhig tu mkha' 'gro ma dar gyi gos dang rus pa'i rgyan ldan bzhis mgrin gcig tu/ tai los lung bstan nā ro'i bu// lhun grub chos kyi blo gros khyod// puṣ+pa ha ri'i dgon pa na// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nā ro pa// skye ba med pa'i dbyings su yal// khyed bzhud na nged dang 'grogs par gshegs// zhes bskul bas rje nyid rgya gar du 'byon par thugs thag bcad/ mar pa mgo yag sogs la chos 'phro rnams tshar bar mdzad/ rang gi yul du byon/ zhing gcig gser du dril/ gser srang phyed sum brgya phyag tu byung ba bsnams/ mgo yag gis rta khra bo mgo dkar sogs phul nas mang yul bar du bskyal/ lam du jo bo rje dang mjal nas khyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa ni na ning gi lo gsar gyi nya la mkha' spyod du gshegs zin pas/ nged kyi lo tsā byas na nā ro pa'i chos gdams ngag thams cad nga yis thob pa yin gsungs pas/ bla ma la lan gcig mjal ba'i dam bca' phul yod zhus pas/ khyod skal pa dang ldan pa zhig tu 'dug pas mjal bar nges so zhes lung bstan zhes jo bo'i rnam thar dpe rnying ma bcos pa rnams na 'dug go/

de nas bal yul du phebs nas bla ma ban+de pa dang pham mthing ba dang mjal tshogs 'khor mdzad pas bla ma mkha' spyod du gshegs zin khyod lo gcig gis phyi zer/ de nas rgya gar du byon/ mai tri pa dang*/ pra dzña rak+shi ta/ dzñā nā ka ra/ ā ka ra sid+dhi/ dza ya ka ra/ ri ri pa rnams dang mjal tshogs 'khor phul nas gsol ba btab pas bla ma mjal bar lung bstan/ dpal nag po shān+ti bha dra mjal der gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pas/ bud med kyi ro zhig tshogs rdzas su 'dug pa'i thod rlon gyi klad pa dang*/ gzungs ma gu h+ya mā tṛ'i dri chu bsres pa de dam rdzas su brim pas mar pa'i thad du sleb pas thod rdzas chil chil du khol ba'i nang du ma hā mā yā'i yig 'bru sngags kyi yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor gzigs/ zab mo sngags kyi de nyid thugs su chud cing*/ dpal nā ro pa mjal bar lung bstan par mdzad do/ /zhi ba bzang po 'di ni mar 'gos gnyis ka'i bla ma yin no// de nas dpal ye shes snying po'i drung du byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ nā ro pa mjal bar lung bstan/ de nas dur khrod so sa gling du byon pas lam pa li pa ṭa zhes bya bar brtol/ der bu mo zhig gis shing tog srung gin 'dug par shing tog slong bas/ des nga'i ma la 'dri dgos zer nas ma sbran byung*/ des lta stangs kyis shing tog phabs nas zo zer bas shing tog gcig bza' bar brtsam pas nang du gdan bzhi ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong nas dbang bskur/ de nas ka so ri pa mjal nas zla ba brgyad dang zhag bdun nas nā ro pa mjal bar dbugs dbyung gnang*/ de nas nā ro pa btsal btsal nas nyin gcig shel gyi pha bong la nā ro'i zhabs rjes rnyed pas da de myur du mjal lo snyam pa'i brod pa skyes/ der maṇ+ḍal dang gsol ba btab pas 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa 'ol spyi dang*/ mi gsal ba dang*/ gsal ba dag rim par mjal yang sku'i rjes ma sleb par yal/

der thod pa rnam snang gis gang ba bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa zhig 'dug pa gsol bas ting 'dzin dpag med brnyes/ de nas gsol ba btab pas ḍā ma ru'i sgra dang bcas te nā ro pa mngon sum du byon te sa la bab/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ gser rnams dang por ma bzhes/ nan gyis zhus pas bzhes te bla ma dkon cog mchod gsungs nas gtor ba na/ 'phangs snyam pa na slar yang gser tshang ma phyir gnang ste/ 'di thams cad gser gling ngo gsungs pas sa gzhi thams cad gser du song*/ der slar tshogs 'khor phul gsungs pas nya khog zhig yod pa tshal pa mang po byas pas bza' bca'i rigs sna drug bcur song*/ der tshogs 'khor mdzad/ dpal dgyes pa rdo rje dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang bskur bas dbang gi ye shes ji lta ba 'khrungs der zla ba gsum du bzhugs zer/ de nas mnga' bdag mai tri pa sogs la phyi phyag mdzad gser lhag ma rnams kyis byang chub chen mo sogs la mchod pa mdzad/ rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod skabs srin po lus tshad che ba zhig shi ba'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad de ro phyi rol du dor bas thams cad kyis lo tsā ba grub thob tu bskur/ de nas bal por phebs/ mi mnyam rdo rje zhes kri ya zhus yin pa de'i gdan sar phebs tshogs 'khor mdzad/ rin chen tshul gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs skabs tho rang gi mnal lam du mnga' bdag mai tri pa seṅge la chibs pa byon te skye med brjod med kyi brda bstan/ mang yul du mar pa mgo yag bsu mar 'byor/ mang yul glang po mkhar du/ zur ban gtsug tor dang*/ ston pa rgyal rgyal gyis dbang dang gdams pa zhus/ khur za gsal skyid zhes pa'i rig ma mtshan ldan zhig phul/ nyang stod stag tshang du mes ston chen pos bsus/ mkhar sgong dkar po zhes pa mar pa mgo yag gi gnyen tshan zhig gis chos gzhi btsugs/ de nas lho brag tu phyags phebs so// de yang bod du phebs dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa'i skabs/

bdag med ma sogs btsun mo dgu khab tu bzhes/ nang ltar grub pa chen po'i sa la bzhugs kyang*/ phyi sbas tshul 'jig rten kun spyod khyim pa'i tshul dang mthun par bzhugs/ rje mi la yang dus 'di tsam na zhabs pad du snyegs te skyo ba dang spro bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad/ jo mo dgu la dar ma mdo sde sogs sras ming sring dgu 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan/ skabs skabs su skal ldan rnams kyi snang ngor grong 'jug sogs thun mong gi grub rtags rnams bstan cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i slob ma dam pa rnams kyi ngor zad par zil gnon dang sku'i bkod pa bcas spros bcas bde chen gyi spyod pa skyong zhing dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mngon sum du snang ba sogs mchog gi sgyu 'phrul gyi rol rtsed cir yang bsgyur zhing*/ gdul bya rnams la smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa bskor bar mdzad pa rdo rje can gyi rgyal tshab dam par bzhugs pa zhig go/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags mo bya'i mchu zla'i nya la rnam par smin pa'i sku lus bor te dag pa ye shes sgyu ma'i skur gshegs pa yin zhes kyang grags mod/ rje btsun 'di ḍom+bi he ru ka dang*/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul par grags shing thams cad mthun snang grub par/ tshogs 'khor mdzad skabs bdag med ma gtso mo dang*/ gzhan jo mo brgyad po gau rī ma brgyad du gyur ba dang*/ rje nyid sku mtshams la bzhugs nas/ chu gang dpal ler rim lnga'i khrid gnang ba'i bkod pa dang*/ tri'i mi'u chung gi ri khrod du bzhugs pa dang*/ dol gyi mda' na dol pa gag ston sogs la bka' chos gnang ba sogs dus gcig la sku'i bkod pa du mar mdzad pa dang*/ jo mo gsal skyid la dris pas ni mo rang sar nub gcig kyang 'bral med du bzhugs pa yin zer/ jo mo snye mo bzang nges ni mo sar 'bral med yin zer/ de sogs ma jo dgu po so sor sku'i bkod pa re rtag tu bzhugs nas/

so sor rim lnga/ rlung sems gnyis med/ phyag rgya bzhi pa/ bsre 'pho sogs gnang ba yin zer kyin 'dug zer ba snang*/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi bu rgyud 'di rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pas khyed bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam sgugs shig gsungs pas der bu chen rnams kyis rmi lam bzung bas rmi lam legs pa kho na byung zhing*/ khyad par du rje btsun mi la la ka chen bzhi'i rmi lam byung ba mgur du snyan gsan phul bas/ de dag gi brda 'grol mgur du bzhengs pa'i don bsdu na/ shar gyi ka chen ni dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge*/ ka thog tu seng ge 'gying ba ni bu chen bzhi/ lho yi ka chen rngog ston/ stag mo ngar ba ni bu chen bzhi/ nub kyi ka chen mes ston/ khyung lding ba bu chen bzhi/ byang gi ka chen mi la/ rgod lding pa bu chen bzhi yin pa sogs kyi lung bstan gyur/ yang bu chen rnams chos gang dang gang gi bka' bab dang phrin las la dbang ba tho rang gi rten 'byung la ye shes kyis gzigs pas/ rngog chos rdor gyis rgyud 'grel 'ga' la bshar sbyang mdzad pa gzigs pas/ nā ro'i rgyan drug dang*/ thugs dam pad+ma rā ga/ dgang gzar blugs/ rgyud 'grel gyi dpe rnams gtad de/ bshad rgyud kyi bka' gtad gtso bor bshad pa'i sgo nas 'gro don gyis shig gsungs/ mtshur ston gyis 'pho ba bsgom pas/ 'pho ba'i man ngag dang*/ nā ro'i dbu lo/ phyag sen/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rnams gnang nas 'pho ba'i bka' bab du lung bstan/ mes ston gyis 'od gsal sgom pas/ 'od gsal gyi gdam pa dang*/ nā ro'i rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nya phyis kyi thod gzugs rnams gnang*/ gtso bor 'od gsal gyi bka' gtad par mdzad/ rje mi las gtum mo sgom pas/ gtum mo sogs chos drug gi gdams pa dang*/ mai tri'i dbu zhwa/ nā ro'i na bza' rnams gnang nas g.ya' ri dang gangs khrod du rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs shig par bka' stsal to/

/de nas dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa brgyad pa bya lo rta zla'i tshes bco lnga la/ bdag med ma 'od kyi thig ler byas te thugs kar thim nas rnam smin gyi sku lus bor te mkha' spyod du gshegs so// ༈¿¿sras dar ma mdo sde ni/ rwa lo chen po'i byad khas/ rje mar pa bzhugs skabs nas chibs las lhungs te sku gshegs tshul dang*/ de dus rje mi la chibs kha pa yin tshul gyi lo rgyus 'byung yang*/ dam pa 'gas sngar nā ro las dbang zhus skabs rten 'byung 'dzol ba las rwa lo'i nus pa tsam gyis ga la yin gsungs pa dang*/ rje sgrol mgon zhabs kyis lo rgyus de rigs shab shob ka yin/ dar ma mdo sde sku 'das dus nas mar pa dang bdag med ma 'das tshar/ mi la yang bsgrub pa la gshegs nas yun song tho skor na med ces gsungs 'dug pa shin tu thugs mad snang zhing*/ dus mtshungs bsgrigs na'ang*/ rje dwags pos zangs dkar ba la yo ga gsan pa yin cing*/ de dang rwa lo dus mnyam yin cing mar pas dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga bzhes dus sras dar ma mdo sde sku 'khrungs par gsungs pas rwa lo mar pa las ches gzhon par bshad pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /de ltar na rje mar pa gshegs zin nas sras mdo sde sku thim pa'i rjes nas sras gzhan rnams la de tsam mi bzhugs pas/ rgya dpe rnams kher gdal 'khyar zhing/ zhal sgo 'phan yul gyi dgon pa zhig tu 'khyar/ mar pa'i sku gdung rnams sras bya rid/ 'khor lo las rngog mdo sdes bslus te da lta gzhung spre zhing na dngul gyi gdung rten bzhengs/ gser gyi gdung khang du bzhugs su gsol zhes rngog mdo sde'i lo rgyus las 'byung bas kyang rtogs nus so// ༈¿¿bka' babs kyi bu chen bzhi yi dang po rngog chos sku rdo rje ni/ rngog lo tsā ba khu dbon dang yab tshan drung yin/ sgyer phu'i dge bshes sgyer chung pa las sngags rnying ma'i mdo rgyud sogs gsan skabs rje mar pa'i snyan pa gsan pas dad pa'i spu long g.yos/

gro bo lung du phyin rje mar pa mjal/ rta zhig phyag rten du phul/ thog mar bdag med lha mo bco lnga zhus nas bsgom pas lha mo bco lnga zhal gzigs/ gzhung du na ma zlum po zhig tu gnas gzhi khyung lta bu zhig btab pas zlum khyung du grags par lan grangs mang por spyan drangs/ ka ca spang dag lan gsum byas te phul/ dgyes rdor/ gur mā yā/ gdan bzhi rnams zhus thos bsgrub stabs su mdzad pas ye shes kyi sku brnyes/ chos skyong dud sol ma gnang*/ dgung lo drug bcu rtsa gcig par ston btsas ma rnga ba'i dus gsung chen pos nga'i phyi la su 'gro 'dod pa shog gsungs pa la gzhan su yang 'gro ba ma byung zhing*/ kun gyis mthong bar nam mkha' la gshegs so/ /bdun brgyud tshun la rdor dril 'dzin shes pas chog pa kho na byung zhing chos brgyud da lta'i bar du kun la khyab pa 'di'o/ /mi las ser ba phab dus kyi bya byi'i ro rnams se gol gtogs pa'i mod di re phur ba sogs bsad pa gso nus pa sogs kyi nus pa mnga'/ ༈¿¿mes ston ni/ myang stag tshal du 'khrungs/ mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan zer/ rje mar pa la 'bul mo che lan gsum mdzad/ gnas gzhi ba tho btab/ rje mar pa yang gdan/ bde dgyes gsang gsum mā yā thod pa rnams zhus/ de rnams kyi bshad grwa yang btsugs/ zhag bdun re la mnal gcig tu 'gro rong ngur smrig tu gshin chog zhig gis sar khong chang gsol kyin gzims rang bzhugs pa la yon bdag zhe ma tshims nas thugs dam mdzad par zhu ba yang yang byas pas/ kho re tsho khyod kyi der ma tshad da lta grong ya gin rgan mo sna khrag zag nas shi song ba de tshun gyi yar 'dren byas yod gsungs/ ltar song bas ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pas thams cad yid ches/ phyis nga zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis la nyal/ de nas ma langs na ro 'di bsreg gsungs/ zhag bcu dgu song mtshams dbon po zhig gis langs mi srid bsam nas bsgul bas shangs khrag mang po byung ste sku mdangs yal song*/

༈¿¿mtshur ston dbang nge ni/ dol gyi mda' mtshur gyi sngags 'chang mthu bo che zhig gi sras yin/ sku bsod shin tu rgyas 'bum bzhengs pa'i drung yig pa dang 'phros gtam la da lta gsang 'dus la su mkhas dris pas/ lho brag mar pa mkhas zer bas/ de nas bla ma lho brag par 'bul ba mdzad/ khyad par du mar pa mon nag la mthu mdzad dus bkod nas bsgral bas mnyes par mdzad/ dol mdar spyan drangs dgyes rdor dang 'dus pa zhabs lugs/ dza ya na/ tha ga na/ snyim pa'i me tog dang bcas pa'i bshad pa'i srol rnams gnang*/ de dag rgyud don man ngag tu 'dril ba'i bshad thabs min pas 'phags lugs la gtsigs che/ lugs bzhi ka gsan khams pa ro mnyam rdo rjes rgya gar du mai tri pa la gsang 'dus zhu snyam phyin pas gshegs nas ma mjal/ gzhan nyan sa ma rnyed nas bod du log nas rje mar pa la zhu snyam pa la/ rgya gar ba gnyis kyang gsang 'dus zhu sa ma rnyed nas rje mar pa'i drung du gsang 'dus zhu ba la 'ong ba dang 'phrad de mar pa'ang gshegs nas mi bzhuḍa pas khong gsum kas mtshur ston la 'dus pa zhus pa yin 'dug cing*/ de ltar rngog mes mtshur gsum la gtso bor bshad rgyud chu bo'i rgyun lta bu'i bka' babs pa yin no//

bod 'dir mar 'gos gnyis zhes 'dra mnyam du byed kyi 'dug na'ang*/ rje mar pa ni 'gos kyi bla ma dzñā na ā ka ra dang nā ro'i drung nas 'dus pa zhus pa'i mched grogs yin pa dang*/ bshad ma thag pa bzhin rgya gar ba rnams kyis chos zhu ba sogs thugs mthong ches che ba dang*/ dpal sa ra ha pa dang ku ku ri pa sogs dang mjal zhing rjes su bzung ba dang*/ lhag pa'i lha mang po las gdams pa thob pa sogs 'gos las kyang khyad par du mas 'phags pa ni gzu bo'i blos dpyad pas rtogs par nus so// gzhan yang mar pa mgo yag dol pa gag ston/ gra'i mi'u chung*/ chu gong dpal le dge bshes khyer gad/ mjal snga ba klog skya ba chen po/ shud kyi lba ba can/ ba rong lba ba can/ rgya ston zhig po/ rgya mkhar gyi zhang ston/ mar pa bya ze ba/ myang sgom sprang lhag /lha rje se ring sogs dang*/ lho pa te sgom ni rje btsun gyi chibs kha ba sku lus 'dis mkha' spyod du byon pa rnams dang*/ sku la 'khrungs pa'i sras bdun ni/ dar ma mdo sde/ dar ma bsam gtan/ chos dpal/ mar le ba/ dpal 'od/ grags 'od/ bya rid 'khor lo rnams so//
